rubrics.justification: Describes a plausible high-quality blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, visible blastocoel, and possible mild handling-related partial collapse; minor uncertainty about exact expansion stage prevents a perfect score.

Integrates age, BMI, AMH/FSH, endometrial thickness, male-factor diagnosis, semen parameters, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis, though some male-factor interpretation is somewhat speculative.
Overall logic is reasonable, but the response contains internal inconsistencies in probability estimates and some contradictory phrasing about semen quality and oocyte maturity.

Generally aligns with IVF practice in supporting single embryo transfer and not routinely recommending PGT-A, but discussion of possible double embryo transfer and some unsupported comments reduce guideline fidelity.

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with SET, luteal support, routine activity, follow-up beta-hCG timing, and sensible next-step evaluation if unsuccessful; useful though not highly detailed.
